approach.name: Gallery
approach.description: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

pages.label: Announcement bar
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Store promise line
sections.intent: A quiet strip on the dark ground that takes turns between the store's promises: delivery across India, easy returns, and a current offer code. Each store sets its own wording, kept warm and short.
sections.layout: a slow marquee of short serif messages, centred, with generous letter-spacing

pages.label: Header
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Site header
sections.intent: Logo, menu, search, account and cart, kept spare so the imagery below leads. It works for any catalogue, from saris to speakers.
sections.layout: centred logo over a thin menu row, search, account and cart icons on the right; on phones a slim bar with the menu tucked into a drawer

pages.label: Home
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Opening campaign picture
sections.intent: One full-bleed campaign image the store swaps each season, with a single serif line and two calls to action (shop new, explore collections), so the first impression is the picture rather than words.
sections.layout: full-bleed image with a dark scrim, words set low on the left

sections.label: Shop by collection
sections.intent: The store's main categories as big picture tiles, so any shopper can jump straight to fashion, home, electronics or whatever this store carries.
sections.layout: bento grid with one large tile and four smaller ones

sections.label: New this season
sections.intent: Latest arrivals as large product pictures with name and price only. The next card peeks in to invite a swipe on phones.
sections.layout: horizontal scroller with the next card peeking

sections.label: Our promises
sections.intent: Three reassurances Indian shoppers look for: delivery across India, easy returns, and secure payment including cash on delivery. Each is said in one warm sentence.
sections.layout: a band in the brand colour with light text, three equal columns with thin dividers

sections.label: The featured edit
sections.intent: One styled lifestyle picture of a curated story beside two hero products from it, giving the store an editorial moment without clutter.
sections.layout: asymmetric 7/5 grid: big picture left, two stacked product cards right

sections.label: Brands we carry
sections.intent: The labels the store stocks, shown as a calm list of names and logos for shoppers who shop by brand.
sections.layout: a heading pinned on the left beside a scrolling list of brand logos

sections.label: Words from shoppers
sections.intent: A few real reviews, one at a time, to build trust for a store the shopper may not yet know.
sections.layout: a centred card floating over a tinted background, cycling slowly

sections.label: Letters from us
sections.intent: A short, warm invitation to join the store's emails for new arrivals and private offers.
sections.layout: centred narrow column with generous space

pages.label: Product listing
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Listing title
sections.intent: A slim serif title with breadcrumbs and the result count, so shoppers know where they are before the pictures take over.
sections.layout: slim band under a thin rule

sections.label: All products
sections.intent: The full catalogue as large picture cards, with filters and sort close by for a mixed catalogue of any kind.
sections.layout: filters in a column on the left, a roomy three-across grid on the right

sections.label: Browse by collection
sections.intent: Category picture tiles after the results, for shoppers who would rather wander by collection.
sections.layout: horizontal scroller with the next tile peeking

pages.label: Category pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Category opening picture
sections.intent: The hero picture of <Category> with its name as the page heading, its tagline and breadcrumbs. Its <SubCategories> appear as quiet chips beneath and hide when there are none.
sections.layout: a full-width band with the words over the picture, chips in a row below

sections.label: Category products
sections.intent: Everything in <Category> as large picture cards under a light toolbar, keeping the images dominant.
sections.layout: result count and sort in a slim toolbar over the grid, filters in a slide-out drawer

sections.label: Questions and notes
sections.intent: The questions shoppers ask about <Category> beside its longer copy from <SeoText>, set quiet and readable. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: two columns: accordion of questions left, text right

pages.label: Brand pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Brand introduction
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, the logo and name of <Brand> as the heading, with its tagline, short description and website and social links.
sections.layout: the logo and words in two columns

sections.label: Brand products
sections.intent: Every product from <Brand> in large picture cards, with filters to narrow down.
sections.layout: filters in a column on the left, the grid on the right

sections.label: Brand story
sections.intent: The story of <Brand> and its longer copy from <SeoText>, set as a calm read at the end. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column with generous space

pages.label: Search results
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Your search
sections.intent: The term and result count from <SearchQuery>, with the search box ready to try again.
sections.layout: slim band under a thin rule

sections.label: Matching pieces
sections.intent: Products that match the search as picture cards, with filters and sort to refine it.
sections.layout: filters in a column on the left, the grid on the right

pages.label: Product page
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Pictures and buying
sections.intent: Large product pictures beside the buy box: title, rating, price, options, quantity, add to cart, buy now, a pincode delivery check and wishlist.
sections.layout: gallery left, sticky buy box right

sections.label: Details and care
sections.intent: Description and specifications that suit any product type, folded so the page stays quiet.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column of accordion rows

sections.label: What buyers say
sections.intent: The average rating beside written reviews, so shoppers can judge quality before buying.
sections.layout: a rating summary pinned on the left beside the review list

sections.label: You may also like
sections.intent: Related products as large picture cards to keep browsing.
sections.layout: full-width band with a centred heading over a horizontal scroller with the next card peeking

pages.label: Cart
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Free delivery progress
sections.intent: How much more to add for free delivery, said simply.
sections.layout: a slim full-width band

sections.label: Your bag
sections.intent: Items with pictures beside the summary, coupon and checkout button, with trust badges for reassurance. A gentle empty state appears when the bag is empty.
sections.layout: lines left, a sticky summary card right

sections.label: Before you checkout
sections.intent: A few small add-ons that pair with what is in the bag.
sections.layout: a horizontal scroller of cards

pages.label: Checkout
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Secure checkout
sections.intent: Contact, address, delivery choice and payment (UPI, cards, cash on delivery) beside the order summary, with a coupon box.
sections.layout: form steps left, a sticky order summary right; the summary first on phones

sections.label: Help and reassurance
sections.intent: Secure payment, easy returns and how to reach the store if something goes wrong.
sections.layout: a quiet centred band with three columns

pages.label: About
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Our opening words
sections.intent: The store's own one-line belief, set large over a picture of its world, filled in by each store.
sections.layout: a full-bleed picture with a centred serif statement over it

sections.label: How we began
sections.intent: The store's story in a few paragraphs beside pictures of its people, place or products.
sections.layout: asymmetric 7/5 grid: words left, stacked pictures right

sections.label: What shoppers say
sections.intent: Customer words that show the store keeps its promises.
sections.layout: a centred card floating over a tinted background

sections.label: Explore the collection
sections.intent: An invitation to shop, through the store's collections as picture tiles.
sections.layout: bento grid with one large tile

pages.label: Contact
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Ways to reach us
sections.intent: Phone, email, WhatsApp and address, each with its hours, so shoppers can pick what suits them.
sections.layout: three equal columns with thin dividers

sections.label: Common questions
sections.intent: Answers on delivery times, returns, cash on delivery and order tracking.
sections.layout: a heading pinned beside the accordion list

sections.label: Call or write
sections.intent: A warm closing nudge to call or message on WhatsApp.
sections.layout: a band in the brand colour with light text and one centred call to action

pages.label: All categories
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Every collection
sections.intent: All categories from <AllCategories> as large picture tiles, each with its subcategories and product count beneath, under a big serif heading with breadcrumbs.
sections.layout: a centred heading over a mosaic with one large tile

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A closing invitation to see every product at once.
sections.layout: a slim band under a thin rule with a single link

pages.label: All brands
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: All our brands
sections.intent: Every brand from <AllBrands>, featured ones shown large first, then the rest as a calm logo wall with taglines and product counts.
sections.layout: a centred heading over a logo wall

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A closing invitation to browse the whole catalogue.
sections.layout: a band in the brand colour with light text

pages.label: Footer
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Store footer
sections.intent: The store's name and one-line promise beside link columns for shopping, help and policies, with social links below.
sections.layout: a large brand line beside the link columns, a slim bottom bar beneath

pages.label: Sign in
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Centred sign-in
sections.intent: Centred sign-in: a short welcome line in the store voice over <SignInForm /> on a softly tinted band, the store name small under it
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface with generous space

sections.label: Reassurance strip
sections.intent: Reassurance strip: a secure sign-in with a one-time code, orders and returns in one place, saved addresses, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface with generous space

pages.label: Sign up
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Centred join
sections.intent: Centred join: a short invitation in the store voice over <SignUpForm /> on a softly tinted band
sections.layout: on a band in the brand colour with light text

sections.label: What an account gives
sections.intent: What an account gives: orders in one place, saved addresses, a wishlist, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: on a band in the brand colour with light text

pages.label: Account pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Account frame
sections.intent: Account frame: a quiet heading strip with a short line about the shopper’s corner of the store, then <AccountPage /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Help band
sections.intent: Help band: where to get help with an order, returns and the policies, as a few quiet links (/support, /return-policy, /legal)
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Order details
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Order page
sections.intent: Order page: a slim band with a link back to all orders (/account/orders), then <OrderDetail /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Help with this order
sections.intent: Help with this order: contact options from <Store> and links to returns (/return-policy) and support (/support)
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Wishlist
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Wishlist
sections.intent: Wishlist: a heading band in the store voice for saved favourites (the page’s h1), then <WishlistGrid /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: More to love
sections.intent: More to love: best sellers from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Compare
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Compare
sections.intent: Compare: a short heading band (the page’s h1) with a line on choosing well, then <CompareTable /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Help choosing
sections.intent: Help choosing: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Policies
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Policies
sections.intent: Policies: <LegalContent /> full width on a calm surface under a thin rule
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Questions
sections.intent: Questions: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Returns
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Returns
sections.intent: Returns: a quiet title strip with the h1, then <ReturnsContent /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Still need help
sections.intent: Still need help: contact options from <Store> and a link to support (/support)
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Help and support
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Help centre
sections.intent: Help centre: a tinted band with the h1 and a short line, then <SupportContent /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Call or message
sections.intent: Call or message: a closing band inviting a call or a WhatsApp message through <Store>
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Page not found
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Lost page
sections.intent: Lost page: a big 404 beside a playful line on a tinted band, then <NotFoundContent />
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: New in
sections.intent: New in: the newest products from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: centred, with generous space
